Proposition
[doubling implies precompact]

Source: petersen:page-0417 ↗ def:pet-ch11-metric-doubling-condition ↗ prop:pet-ch11-gromov-precompactness-criterion 1. ch11:11.1.12A family $\mathcal{C}\subset (\mathcal{M},\dGH )$ with a common doubling constant $C<\infty $ and $\diam X\le D<\infty $ for every member, then $\mathcal{C}$ is precompact.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch11-doubling-implies-precompact \sketch Iterating the doubling hypothesis covers every $X$ by at most $C^N$ balls of radius $2^{-N}D$. Choosing $N$ from $\varepsilon $ yields a uniform covering function, so subsection 1.4 applies.

□
